program.department: Environmental Systems Program (Scripps Institution of Oceanography, UC San Diego)

notes: Corroborated against the 2019-20 registrar catalog. CORRECTIONS to the harvested lower division: (1) this track requires BILD 1 AND 3 (harvested listed only BILD 3); (2) SIO 50 is NOT required for this track and was removed; (3) the math requirement is MATH 10A-B (or 20A-B) and MATH 11 - NOT MATH 20A-B-C-D as harvested; (4) physics is the PHYS 1A/1AL-1B/1BL-1C/1CL series OR PHYS 2A-B-C. Upper-division core (ESYS 101/102/103, ECON 131, POLI 160AA, BICD 100 Genetics, ESYS 190A/190B) and the 5-course restricted elective list are verified verbatim. C- or better and letter grades required.

buckets.label: Introductory Biology
buckets.note: This track requires BILD 1 AND BILD 3 (verified). Harvested omitted BILD 1.

buckets.label: Physics sequence
buckets.note: Accepted: PHYS 2A-B-C, OR the PHYS 1A+1AL / 1B+1BL / 1C+1CL series. Canonical set shown here.

buckets.label: Calculus sequence
buckets.note: 19-20 catalog: MATH 10A-B (or 20A-B) and MATH 11. Corrected from harvested MATH 20A-D, which is wrong for this track; MATH 20A-B may substitute for 10A-B.

buckets.label: Senior Project & Senior Seminar
buckets.note: Capstone. 190A = two-quarter, 8-unit senior project; 190B = senior seminar.

buckets.label: Genetics (track core)
buckets.note: Required core for the EBE track.

buckets.label: Ecology / Behavior / Evolution advanced electives
buckets.note: Choose 5 (verified verbatim); at least one of the five must be a laboratory course.
